related.title: U-Net：編碼解碼與跳接對齊
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付patch座標、核成本與邊界對齊測試。；計算結果正確且patch數為3136；脈衝峰值與預定中心對齊。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver patch coordinates, kernel costs and boundary-alignment tests.; Counts match with3136 patches, and the impulse peak aligns with its intended center.
related.difference: 畫跳接與上採樣的原點、像素中心及裁切框；56×56串接須同一座標系。；兩案裁切量4與6正確，合成十字中心偏差為0格。
related.differenceEn: Draw origins, pixel centers and crop bounds;56×56 tensors must share coordinates before concatenation.; Crops4 and6 match and the synthetic-cross center has zero-cell offset.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 無重疊patchify步幅s將H×W縮成H/s×W/s；深度卷積k×k每輸出位置每通道用k² MAC。；教學H=W=224,s=4,C=32,k=7；另比較k=3。；MAC=56²×32×49=4917248；k3時903168。
對稱中心裁切每邊c=(Hskip−Hup)/2；奇數差需明定偏置方向。；教學跳接寬64、上採樣寬56；另一案上採樣寬52。；c=(64−56)/2=4 px；改52時c=6 px。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Nonoverlapping stride-s patchification gives H/s×W/s positions; a depthwise k×k filter costs k² MACs per channel and position.; Teaching H=W=224,s=4,C=32,k=7, compared with k=3.; MAC=56²×32×49=4917248; k3 gives903168.
Symmetric crop per side is c=(Hskip−Hup)/2; odd differences require an explicit directional convention.; Teaching skip width64, upsampled width56; alternative52.; c=(64−56)/2=4 px; width52 gives6 px.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CLIP：影文對比與溫度校準
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付patch座標、核成本與邊界對齊測試。；計算結果正確且patch數為3136；脈衝峰值與預定中心對齊。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver patch coordinates, kernel costs and boundary-alignment tests.; Counts match with3136 patches, and the impulse peak aligns with its intended center.
related.difference: 畫兩圖兩文字的相似度矩陣，標對角配對；區分影到文列正規化與文到影欄正規化。；兩機率值誤差小於1e−6，列欄損失方向與配對索引皆有測試。
related.differenceEn: Draw a two-image/two-text matrix with diagonal pairs; distinguish row image-to-text from column text-to-image normalization.; Both probabilities agree within1e−6, with tests for loss direction and pairing indices.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 無重疊patchify步幅s將H×W縮成H/s×W/s；深度卷積k×k每輸出位置每通道用k² MAC。；教學H=W=224,s=4,C=32,k=7；另比較k=3。；MAC=56²×32×49=4917248；k3時903168。
兩候選相似度差Δ以溫度τ形成p=1/(1+exp(−Δ/τ))；僅為一列二候選示例。；教學相似度.8與.2，τ=.2，改τ=.4。；p=1/(1+exp(−3))=.952574；τ.4得.817574。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Nonoverlapping stride-s patchification gives H/s×W/s positions; a depthwise k×k filter costs k² MACs per channel and position.; Teaching H=W=224,s=4,C=32,k=7, compared with k=3.; MAC=56²×32×49=4917248; k3 gives903168.
For two candidates with similarity gap Δ, p=1/(1+exp(−Δ/τ)); this is one row of a two-candidate example.; Teaching similarities.8 and.2, τ=.2 then.4.; p=1/(1+exp(−3))=.952574; τ.4 gives.817574.
